why: Unfinalized events must be pending, never proof.
If any copy of an event is not finalized, the event is pending (U9).
Copies of one event that disagree must leave every named escrow unverified (U5).
Every escrow any copy names is unverified, not only the ones named by later copies (U5).
Copies of one event must agree on block_number; null against a number disagrees.
An unreadable event page makes every escrow unverified (U4).
A structurally invalid page makes every escrow unverified, it is not skipped (U4).

find: if ((page["from_block"] as number) > (page["to_block"] as number)) return "block range is inverted";
why: An inverted block range is a structurally invalid page (census clause 12).
Events from another genesis must be excluded.
The same event seen twice must count once.
A finalized release plus a finalized refund must stay unverified.
An escrow id that is not 0x plus 64 hex is malformed.

find: const escrowEvent = raw["section"] === SECTION && typeof method
why: Only hasStation events are evidence; a gateway event with the same method name is not.

find: export const ESCROW_SCOPE = "settlement only; says nothing about output quality" as const;
replace: export const ESCROW_SCOPE = "settlement and output quality" as unknown as "settlement only; says nothing about output quality";
why: Every result must carry the fixed scope string.

find: if (typeof index !== "number" || !Number.isInteger(index) || index < 0) return "index is not a whole number";
replace: if (typeof index !== "number" && typeof index !== "string") return "index is not a whole number";
why: Events with wrong field types must be ignored.
A finalized terminal event whose id does not parse is conflicting evidence.
Funded needs no finalized terminal event; a release must win over an open.
An event above the finalized height is not finalized evidence.
